notes.design: Rebuild lark_husked to art-bible section 6. Remove 15-30% of outer plates along the shell's own seams so the frame shows, burn the remaining paint to husk black #121416 with rust at fasteners, and scrawl glyph fragments. Noon and open-space show a purple and magenta shell with only the wing lattice opened; the silhouette stays a Lark, which is right, but it does not read as Hollow.
notes.materials: Rebake husked Hull, Accent, and Trim off the purple atlas. The material balls and the noon and open-space frames are magenta and purple, and the night frame has no #9FE8DA seam glow. Keep the base pearl and sea-green paint. It stays matte under noon, night, and open space, with grime in the rib grooves and no blown metal. Replace the damaged Glass map. Its ball is a field of white scribbles.
notes.topology: Regenerate LOD2 with the shell normals and UVs kept. At the same camera, LOD0 is a continuous scallop and LOD2 breaks into faceted shards, dark holes, and a hotter wing in noon, night, and open space. That faceted read is what the 100 m frame shows. LOD0 wire is even. Triangle chains pass (LOD3 is 2.7%, 2.5%, 2.5% of LOD0).
notes.fitness: Fix the open canopy so the glass panes hinge clear of each other. stills/lark_cockpit_open_top.png shows the panes crossing in a bowtie. Add a BAY empty for the single cargo pod. The overlay reports no BAY_*. Hardpoints HP_S_1 and HP_S_2 sit on the wing-root mounts, the side ladder meets the cockpit sill, and the five colliders wrap body, nacelles, and wings.

consistency_disclosure: Peer-hull stills (Swift, Kestrel, Mule) were not in the packet. Scored against Compact/Thalune art-bible language and internal base/damaged/husked coherence.
